rows.title: Tracking works end to end
rows.text: Every test sign-up on 2, 5 and 6 Oct was attributed to the source it was sent from (paid social, paid search, email, social, other campaigns) in HubSpot, and recorded as sign_up and login events in Google Analytics.

rows.title: 11 external people signed up in the platform, 2 from Colombia
rows.text: Since 1 Oct PostHog shows 11 new external people with an email (India 4, Philippines 2, Colombia 2, Canada, Malaysia and the Netherlands 1 each), plus 9 internal. They arrived directly (4), from think4ever.com (3), Google (2), LinkedIn (1) and another workspace (1).

rows.title: No campaign is sending traffic to the landing yet
rows.text: Since 7 Oct the landing receives 0 to 3 sessions a day (12 sessions and 3 new users in Google Analytics). Sign-ups and sign-up events in that window: 0.

rows.title: The LATAM landing is not yet in the sign-up path
rows.text: No external sign-up came from go.think4ever.com. Its HubSpot form has only internal tests, and "Sign up with Google" goes straight to the platform. In Colombia, think4ever.com had 32 visitors, 15 CTA clicks and 9 sign-up starts in the same period.

rows.title: 37 visits landed on a missing page
rows.text: go.think4ever.com/404 received 37 views. One or more links point to an address that does not exist; fixing it before paid traffic starts avoids paying for visits that never see the landing.
